# Lessons learned and optimizations

## Lessons learned

The Builder Sub-Crate Pattern — an ultra-thin main crate over an FFI sys crate over a builder sub-crate — resolves the fundamental tension between feature richness and build performance.

## Optimizations

First builds drop from 10–15 minutes (duckdb-rs source builds) to 2–5 seconds using prebuilt universal binaries.

Subsequent builds take about 0.1 seconds from the global cache under ~/.frozen-duckdb/.

No DYLD_* environment variables are needed: the frozen dylib carries the neutral install name @rpath/libduckdb.dylib and the frozen-duckdb build script emits the matching runtime rpath for binaries, tests, and examples.

Download size is about 117MB for the universal binary (arm64 + x86_64), roughly 40% smaller than the ~200MB it replaces.
